verdict.rationale: The evidence shows cross-project visibility features: Everything Views pull items from all projects onto one page, a timeline shows overlaps, start and end dates and key dates, and Hill Charts show progress. None of it documents linking or tracking dependencies between teams' work items. These are adjacent visibility features, not the named capability, so they earn no partial credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track cross-team dependencies to coordinate large launches
